items.quote: Several respondents noted that Jolin championed user research with residents on the new app and it became a model adopted by other agencies.
Peers observed that Jolin led the use of survey numbers to decide where to put new clinics across the department.
Jolin managed lean process reviews at the service centres for their unit.
They handled negotiations with contractors on the service agreement competently within their team.
Several respondents noted that Jolin gained initial exposure to adoption of new technology tools for case officers.
